dateSource: Original EXIF DateTimeOriginal and recorded local offset; UTC-looking Pixel filenames are not treated as local calendar dates. All new selections are Pixel 7 photographs.
reviewScope: 29 contact sheets cover every dated JPEG from 29 December 2023 through 15 October 2024 inclusive. All 209 candidates were reviewed again in 11 larger sheets. Existing Vancouver, Toronto and Ontario exports were visually compared; 17 candidates were dropped. The 1,029 later dated stills are outside this update; three undated imports are omitted without assigning dates.
notes: Whistler, Bowen Island and Deep Cove belong to the existing Vancouver album.
Niagara Falls and Kingston belong to Around Ontario. Toronto remains its own album.
All original selections and covers are retained, including every photograph after the cutoff.
Only quality-84 WebP derivatives are exported at up to 2,000 pixels, with framing and ICC profiles retained and EXIF/XMP omitted.
Original GPS and review sheets stay outside the site and R2.
